market_context.primary_regime: bull-trend / breakout-spike (D1 and H4 both current, always_in long)
market_context.location: M15 bull flag at the highs; entry just above the 2700 H4 breakout level, below the rejected 2850 spike high

setup.type: bull-flag breakout / breakout-pullback continuation above the 2700 H4 breakout

trigger.reference: M15 bar 119 high — buy stop above the bull-flag breakout bar

invalidation.reference: M15 bar 111 low — low of the 11-bar flag (2709.56), which held above the 2700 H4 breakout level

evidence_for: H4 context (current) is bull-trend/breakout-spike with always_in long: H4 bar 120 close 2723.15 is the window's highest close and sits above the twice-tested 2700 highs (H4 bars 108 and 118).

H1 bar 119 (open 2723.15, high 2736.56, low 2719.08, close 2734.09) is a bull trend bar closing in its top fifth and at a new high above the prior H1 highs 2727.01/2727.03 — two hesitation bars then a fresh-high bull bar.

M15 bars 107-118 formed an 11-bar tight range 2709.56-2728.59 after the 2850 spike (M15 bar 106); its lows 2709.56 (111), 2713.04 (112), 2718.37 (114), 2719.99 (116), 2719.15 (118) all hold well above the 2700 breakout level, i.e. the pullback was bought above the breakout point.

M15 bar 119 (open 2725.29, high 2736.56, low 2721.85, close 2734.09) clears the range high 2728.59 and closes near its high — the bull-flag breakout trigger, with structural invalidation only ~27 points lower at the flag low.
evidence_against: H4 bar 120 left a 126.85 upper tail (high 2850 rejected) and M15 bar 106 (high 2850, close 2739.13) shows that spike was sold, so 2736.56 could be a lower high under the rejected extreme.
The entry sits mid-range inside H4 bar 120 (2658.06-2850) rather than at a clean edge, and the M15 breakout exceeds the 2728.59 range high by only ~8 points with no follow-through bar yet.
H4 bar 120 closes only ~23 above the 2700 double top, and two prior upside spikes (H4 bar 61 high 2680, bar 81 high 2609.02) were fully retraced, so failed-breakout precedent exists at this location.
uncertainty: Trigger 2736.56 is a pending buy stop; no fill is guaranteed.
Whether the 2850 wick is exhaustion or a stop-run is unresolved by the closed H1/H4 bars.
The H1 breakout is young — only one H1 bar above 2727 — so continuation is unconfirmed.
conditions_that_change_market_read: M15 close back below 2709.56 (flag low) would mark the bull-flag breakout as failed and cancel the long.
H1 close back below 2700 would re-establish the H4 2357-2700 range and shift the read to trading-range at the highs.
M15/H1 close above 2736.56 with the low holding above 2721.85 would confirm follow-through and strengthen the continuation read.
